result.topic_en: Riemann's case analysis of the differential equations for a rotating fluid ellipsoid: when the axes and the quantities v, v', w, w' are constant, he derives the ratios v'/v and w'/w, auxiliary quantities, and integral expressions, and gives conditions for real solutions.

methods.what: Algebraic conditions on v,v',w,w' from the last six differential equations when the quantities are constant
Ratios of squared quantities expressed in terms of a,b,c
Definition of auxiliary quantities theta and tau
Linear equations for theta, tau from the first three differential equations
Integral expression for sigma via elimination
Integral expressions for theta and tau
